market_education.summary_en: Markets rallied broadly today with tech leading the way, as the NASDAQ outpaced the S&P 500, suggesting investors rotated into growth and momentum names. Semiconductor and AI-adjacent stocks like NVDA and CHRN saw particularly strong volume, hinting at renewed institutional buying interest. No major macro catalyst stands out from available data, so the move looks driven by sector-level momentum rather than a single headline event.
market_education.summary_zh: 今日大市普遍上揚，科技股表現領先，納斯達克指數升幅跑贏標普500，顯示資金再次流向增長及強勢動能股。半導體及人工智能相關股份如NVDA及CHRN均錄得明顯放量，反映機構資金或重新入市。目前未見明顯宏觀消息刺激，今次升浪較似是板塊性動能帶動，而非單一新聞事件所致。

daily_lesson.explanation_en: Volume confirmation means a price move is backed by unusually high trading activity, which suggests many investors — often institutions — are participating, not just a few random traders. A bullish signal paired with a volume surge is considered more reliable than the same signal on light volume.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 成交量確認是指股價的變動伴隨著異常高的交易量，顯示有大量投資者（通常包括機構資金）參與其中，而非僅是零星交易。當利好訊號同時出現放量情況，其可信度通常比低成交量時的同類訊號更高。
